replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: Don't the crops make it to where you can't build on the map, though?

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
It is difficult to block-spam on the parts of the map where there are crops.

I dislike block-spam, so I see no issues with this.

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body: Looks pretty cool, but like {tag=bf3319534f9243ee8abc7544b8234936} said, it would be annoying to build and I feel that the crops might cause lag since it is everywhere.
replies.body_tagged: Looks pretty cool, but like  ViceTechnicolour said, it would be annoying to build and I feel that the crops might cause lag since it is everywhere.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: The entirety of the map is crops. You're sacrificing building at all because of potential block spam.
replies.body_tagged: The entirety of the map is crops. You're sacrificing building at all because of potential block spam.

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
That's an interesting assertion, since when looking at the overhead view, this is what I saw:

What would you even expect people to build on the front lines? They can still place blocks; all that's necessary is to remove a few crops by breaking them (or using the water that is quite abundant on those lanes).

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: Well, I'd expect people to build cover at the very least. It's inconvenient to have to destroy crops, but whatever.

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: Skybridges and cover from arrows are two common stctures often built on the front lines. The crops would make this tedious to do.
